newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends mostly higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends mostly higher in thin trade.

text.p: LIFFE sugar ended mostly firmer on the New York market's strength, traders said.
Front month August dominated volume, with 800 of 1,080 lots. It last changed hands $2.20 higher at $315.00.
The only exception to the rise was October 1997, which traded just 30 lots. It last traded 20 cents down at $304.60
"The August's steady but it's just a function of New York being reasonably strong," one trader said. The rise was just a progression, he said.
Given the thin volume, the day had been "pretty much a waste of time," the trader said.

Earlier, technical analysts said they expected the upward momentum to continue for the time being as the position was well supported, not yet overbought and still holding above a three month trendline.
